test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

It is he who work for the company for more than a decade.
solution:
The correct answer is 'B' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'who work' is incorrect.
 
• The correct form should use 'works' since the relative pronoun 'who' refers to 'he,' which is a singular pronoun.
 
• Thus, the verb should match the singular subject, making the correct form 'who works.'

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *It is he who **works** for the company for more than a decade.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When the subject is singular, the verb should also be singular for subject-verb agreement.
 
• In relative clauses, ensure the verb agrees with the antecedent of the relative pronoun.
